summary_en: This Phase 1/1b study is testing KIN-2787 (also called exarafenib), alone or with binimetinib, in adults with BRAF or NRAS mutation-positive solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma. KIN-2787 is taken by mouth twice daily in 28-day cycles, and binimetinib is also taken by mouth, with an intermittent cohort taking it twice daily for 5 days on and 2 days off in each 28-day cycle. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics), and preliminary antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/1b evalúa KIN-2787 (también llamado exarafenib), solo o con binimetinib, en adultos con tumores sólidos que tienen una mutación en BRAF o NRAS, incluidos el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y el melanoma. KIN-2787 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en ciclos de 28 días, y binimetinib también se toma por vía oral; en una cohorte intermitente se toma dos veces al día durante 5 días seguidos y luego 2 días de descanso en cada ciclo de 28 días. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia, cómo el organismo procesa el fármaco (farmacocinética) y la actividad preliminar contra el tumor.
who_for: Known BRAF Class I, II, or III alteration, or melanoma with an NRAS mutation, confirmed by tumor tissue or ctDNA testing.
Measurable disease, or evaluable disease in Part A only, by RECIST v1.1.
Adequate organ function and able to swallow, retain, and absorb oral medicines.
not_for: Other active cancer treated within 3 years before enrollment.
In Part B dose expansion, prior approved or in-development BRAF, MEK, or MAPK-directed inhibitor therapy.
GI disease that prevents oral medicine, causes malabsorption, needs IV feeding, or is uncontrolled inflammatory GI disease.
Active, uncontrolled bacterial, fungal, or viral infection, or positive, known, or suspected SARS-CoV-2.
